combo_label: The Garage × Horses & Riding × Codes & Ciphers

entries.clue: Male that has been cut: no use at stud, but steadier under a rider
Loud carrying call sent from one field across to another
Distress call sent as three short, three long, three short
Triangular blade with a shaped wooden grip, run along a pencil line
Pointed tool for pressing marks into clay or wax
Thoroughbred in training at Newmarket or Lambourn, bred for speed
Renaissance cipher that shifts by a repeating key, long thought unbreakable
Twelve-month-old led round the ring at the autumn bloodstock sales
Wide rubber lip on a handle, wiping a wet window clear in one stroke
Steel tripod with a toothed pillar, holding a corner up while a wheel is off
Cockney rhyming ___, designed to baffle the listener
Long pin with a flat head, sunk below the surface with a punch
Clattering electromechanical machine that hunted rotor settings
Stiff canvas square spread across the floor to catch every splash
